selection_disclosure.reason: The original V75 development gate rejected the combined long-short ZEC family. The user subsequently required every retained roster asset to trade, so V79 opened the unchanged validation window and selected only the positive long slice before inspecting the pseudo-holdout.

frozen_candidate.entry: fresh completed-4h close above the prior completed 20-bar high, entered no earlier than the next 15m open
frozen_candidate.exit: completed-4h close below the prior completed 10-bar low, executed no earlier than the next 15m open
frozen_candidate.initial_stop: signal close minus 2.0 times 20-bar Wilder ATR

risk_contract.rationale: Probation sizing bounds exposure because side selection is post-hoc and the sample is small.

support_criteria: long-only net PnL is positive under nominal and stress friction
long-only profit factor exceeds 1.0 under nominal and stress friction
long-only net PnL remains positive after removing its largest winner under nominal and stress friction
at least three long lifecycles complete
existing no-lookahead and append-invariance signal tests pass
failure_disposition: Do not authorize this ZEC route; develop a new preregistered mechanism or leave V79 technically incomplete rather than relabeling a failed strategy.
